Seafile 14.0.11 with its notification server, and setup guides for Proxmox VE, Synology, QNAP and UGREEN.

## 🎨 Design

- The README has buttons and setup sections for Proxmox VE, Synology, QNAP and UGREEN, with a note that Seafile runs on x86 only.
- The banner, the screenshots and the section titles are set in the house typeface. A row of download buttons that wraps on a narrow screen stays centred, in Firefox as well.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Seafile 14.0.11 and the notification server 14.0.11.** Upstream still labels Seafile 14 as testing, so back up the data folder and the database before you update.
- **Fresh building blocks.** certifi 2026.11.20.
- **The published image stays current between releases.** Every Monday the pending Ubuntu updates go on top of `latest`. When nothing changed, nothing is pushed.
- Questions go to GitHub issues, together with bugs and ideas.
